paragraphs.text:
You secure your gear and inch your way along a submerged 
ledge, fighting against the rushing, knee-deep water. It narrows 
at the fissure, and there the hazard is greatest.

Make a DEX roll for Bernard: if he succeeds, go to 642; if he fails, 
go to 643.
